rationale: Public broadcaster economy desk: standalone, free, reliable record of CBCG/ministry and bank-project announcements.
Cross-outlet sr-language aggregator that keeps producing discovery signals; cheap continuous monitoring layer.
Second-tier ME portal with occasional substantive CBCG payments coverage; useful breadth/corroboration.
Small ME portal carrying IFI-financing items that lead bank/state digital procurement.
Credible regional broadcaster covering ME payments infrastructure in a Western-Balkans comparative frame.
Serbian business desk republishing ME banking/payments items; redundancy when ME originals are blocked.
Small regional portal carrying syndicated bank PR only; largely redundant with CdM coverage.
One-off CoE media-sector study; valuable as an outlet/ownership map, not a recurring signal producer.
Ahrefs competitor lists are a one-time domain-discovery mine and mostly gated behind a paid account.
Dominant regional POS/ATM/acquiring vendor serving ME banks; Printec's most direct competitor disclosure surface.
App-store developer/package metadata is the cheapest reliable vendor-to-ME-bank mapping; failed check is a soft signal only.
High-value ME banking category but one of 9 bankar.me siblings; monitor at domain level.
Regional tech trade press with technical detail on integrator/fintech wins reaching ME subsidiaries.
Regional integrator with a Podgorica entity competing for ME core-banking/open-banking work; standalone vendor site.
Chamber member record identifying local vehicles of regional integrators; mine once, and URL liveness needs re-check.
Group IR/news site announcing digital-channel programmes before the Montenegrin subsidiary does.
Largest ME bank and key POS/acquiring evidence, but this about-page is one of 4 ckb.me siblings and failed verification.
Single vendor case study naming CKB; strong evidence artifact, and the pattern justifies mining vendor libraries generally.
HT/DT-owned Zagreb integrator with a natural channel into ME enterprise/banking infrastructure work.
Large Croatian integrator bidding regional financial-sector ICT tenders; references filed only on the HR site.
Confirmed developer of a Montenegrin bank's mobile channel; vendor site invisible from ME domains.
Regional business aggregator with central-bank and payments tag pages catching ME items placed in regional press.
Low-credibility regional portal largely duplicating payments coverage already captured elsewhere.
ME ICT cluster member directory to mine for local delivery arms and subcontractors of regional vendors.
Job ads/company posts pre-announce platform rollouts, but LinkedIn requires login and has restrictive scraping terms.
Partner directory mapping which regional firms hold Adriatic implementation rights; mine once, refresh rarely.
Local Podgorica payment-terminal reseller — last-mile channel directly competitive with Printec.
